description_en: Queries DDoS attack events for a specified IP address by calling DescribeDDoSEvents
description_zh: 调用DescribeDDoSEvents查询指定IP的DDoS攻击事件
name: DescribeDDoSEvents

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the traffic query. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 流量查询的开始时间戳，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the traffic query. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 流量查询的结束时间戳，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The elastic IP address (EIP) to query
parameters.name: eip

parameters.help_en:
The start position of the results to return, which specifies the number of results to skip. 
If you do not specify this parameter, results are returned starting from position 0
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果开始位置，即从几个结果开始返回。 
若不传入该参数，则从第0个结果开始返回。
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The page size, which specifies the number of results to display on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页显示的结果个数。最大值50。
parameters.name: page_size

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the event. Unit: milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 事件结束时间，单位：毫秒

Interval.description_en: The duration of the event. Unit: seconds

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the event. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 事件开始时间，单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The event type. Valid values:
lackhole_start: Black Hole Activated
blackhole_end: blackhole filtering ended
defense_start: Cleaning
defense_end: traffic scrubbing ended
Status.description_zh:
事件类型：
lackhole_start：黑洞中
blackhole_end：黑洞结束
defense_start：清洗中
defense_end：清洗结束
